purpose: Fresh semantic verification target. Rebuild the graph checks from these data before reading the discovery checker.
conventions: Ordinary rooted MAF without rho. Internal tree vertices are unsuppressed for disjointness. Source components are separate trees; their leaf sets partition target leaves in completion examples. Local source labels may be a subset of target labels. Cost equals final pieces minus initial source components.
hypotheses_to_attack: pure overlap requires degree two in both embeddings at every overlap vertex
marked local one-cut refinement preserves every old mark and every other source/target piece
globally at most one remaining piece requires repair
empty marked-deletion regions are ignored when counting r
role swap preserves vertex-disjointness under suppression
formal_claims: PureBridge.lean has 16 Std-only theorems about rooted convex regions and a conditional exchange interface. MarkInteraction.lean has 8 finite executable-model theorems importing RMAF.lean. No graph equivalence or unrestricted complexity theorem is claimed.
acceptance: Independently reconstruct every example, test deliberately corrupted values and overlapping forests, inspect theorem hypotheses against consumers, retain source hashes and actual Lean/axiom logs. Agreement by an author of the discovery code is not fresh certification.
